create_shift_bijector: create a Shift bijector with a JAX array shift parameter for elementwise translation
test_shift_forward: test the Shift bijector forward method to verify y equals x plus shift
test_shift_inverse: test the Shift bijector inverse method to verify x equals y minus shift
test_shift_log_det_jacobian: test the Shift bijector forward and inverse log determinant jacobian methods return zero
test_shift_jittable: test that the Shift bijector forward method is compatible with JAX JIT compilation
